_doc: Ratchets on the files that only ever grow. `node tools/check/ratchets.mjs` checks, `--update` snaps every ceiling to the current value (lower after an extraction; a raise is a deliberate edit with its reason in the commit). Metrics: lines (split-newline), codeLines (non-comment non-blank), gMembers (G facade members, check-gctx), topLets (column-0 `let`). Tree-wide metrics (scope `tree`, measured by tools/check/tree-counts.mjs): cssClasses (distinct class tokens in css/), shellNodes (index.html tag occurrences less script/link), bareCatches (empty, uncommented catch blocks in js/), waitNoPolling (waitForFunction with a declared timeout and no polling), and the four CSS token-adoption counts subFloorFontSize / rawSpacing / rawColor / rawColorDistinct, which carry `slack: 0` because they have always asserted exact equality — a migration must lower them, not bank headroom. `node tools/check/tree-counts.mjs --offenders` prints the breakdown behind any of them. An entry may declare its own `slack` when its guard is TIGHTER than the default max(60, 4%) — all four of these are, and a slack looser than the default is refused, so consolidating mechanisms cannot quietly widen one. History: docs/notes/CEILING-HISTORY.md.
